ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.

17. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

18. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.

22. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Care PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Food/ PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Animals ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Weather ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
